core_meaning.short_meaning: Incisive observer; companion Mijzaz al-Mudliji, famed physiognomist.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mijzaz (مِجْزَاز) is an authentic Arabic masculine given name meaning 'incisive, sharp-sighted observer' or 'one of keen discernment'. In Islamic history, it is the renowned name of Mijzaz al-Mudliji, the famed companion and master of physiognomy (Qiyāfah) whose accurate observation of the lineage of Usama ibn Zayd brought joy and radiant delight to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Derived from jazza (to cut cleanly, sever doubt, or decide decisively), signifying a sharp mind and decisive insight.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: During pre-Islamic times, hypocrites cast slurs against Usama ibn Zayd because he was dark-skinned while his father Zayd was fair. One day, Zayd and Usama were sleeping under a cloak with only their feet exposed. Mijzaz passed by and remarked: 'These feet are from one another.' In Sahih al-Bukhari, Aisha narrates that the Prophet ﷺ entered her room with his blessed face shining like a mirror with joy because Mijzaz's expert confirmation silenced the slanderers.
